agent: # Usage: This file defines the utility weights for different agent types in the TI-City model.
# Each row corresponds to an agent type (dp=deprived, li=low-income, mi=middle-income, hi=high-income, mi_red=mid real estate developer, hi_red=high real estate developer).
# Columns represent factors influencing location decisions: suburban, neighbour, bu (built-up), cbd, mall, markets, road, density, schools, attractive, health, random, water, exposed, nom-slope.
# Higher values indicate stronger preference for that factor. Zero values mean the factor is ignored for that agent type.
